result.details:
Target verified with git rev-parse HEAD in a disposable clone at /tmp/opencode/rev06/target; /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead, clean, no commits.

F1 HIGH src/safety.ts:14 (+28,+35): the scan roots include SWARMFORGE_GIT_TREE whenever it startsWith('/'), so a documented local path (docs/CONFIGURATION.md:79) is walked as worker output. A bare tree fails rev-parse --show-toplevel, then os.walk reports 'files outside a Git repository'; a non-bare local path fails with 'commits not represented by remote refs'. Repro (probes/safety-bare.ts, exit 0): clean workspace, empty git status, rev-list --branches HEAD --not --remotes = 0, yet safe:false for both absolute forms and safe:true for a non-absolute ssh URL. Consequence: coordinator.ts:952 refuses every non-forced destroy and coordinator.ts:802 sends every failure to recovery_required, retaining billable VMs; the only exit is force=true, which skips all checks (coordinator.ts:912). Fix: scan only SWARMFORGE_WORKSPACE and result.git.workspace, or skip non-work-tree roots.

F2 MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:944: destroy awaits bounded(inspectPersistence(...)) with no catch, unlike the identical fail() call at 788-798 which yields recovery_required. bounded() rejects on the outer promise so the internal catch in safety.ts:48 never runs; step() swallows it (510-518) and intent=destroy is retried every poll with no backoff, error 'Provider or OpenCode operation failed; retrying within deadline' (deadline not even consulted at 440-443). Repro (probes/destroy-timeout.ts, exit 0, API timeout 40ms, GIT_CHECK never settles): control() resolved without throwing, after 3 ticks state=running intent=destroy, VM retained; same timeout on the deadline path gave recovery_required. Fix: catch and transition to recovery_required.

F3 LOW src/security.ts:126 (+144), coordinator.ts:969: force_destroy is stored (coordinator.ts:833) but never exposed by publicWorker nor recorded in the worker.destroyed event data (store.ts:166), so a forced destroy cannot be distinguished from a verified one after the fact.

Checked sound: vmMissing trusts only a provider 404 (freestyle.ts:92) and destroyWorker swallows 404 only (freestyle.ts:285); confirmed-absent guests skip retention and settle in one call; the active-dispatch/persisted gate runs before the guest probe and force is re-patched per call; persisted=true is set only after a verified push (coordinator.ts:697-703) and backstopped by the guest-side status/rev-list probe.

Limitations: F1 not exercised on a real guest mount; F2 trigger inferred from the script's 15s-per-command bound; F3 code-evidenced only; reconciliation, cancel/pause, quota, config and packaging not assessed. No real provider, network, VM or credential use; reviewers' experiments only under /tmp/opencode/rev06.
